# Alpine

> Software companies that grew on referrals get the attention their good work deserves, from the buyers who don't know them yet.

Alpine LTD, founded 2024. One page, English.

## The page

- What it is: What you already say about your work becomes your presence on every platform your buyers use, in your own words and under your own name.
- How it works for the people who need you: You're already in front of the people who need you, in the posts they watch and the views you both hold, so there's nothing left for them to find.
- The record: Because we come from the same world, the road you're on is one we travel too, and we learn from each other as we both move toward our goals.
- Free help: We share what we learn about reaching buyers who don't know you yet, and all of it is free to use, whether we ever work together or not.
- About: We built this company because sharing what you know is the one free way left to earn attention, and when you keep showing up, that presence grows until the right people already know and trust you.
- [See if you're a fit](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#ask): Before anything starts, we have a short call to see if this fits you, because it only works when it feels like yours.
